## Panel 1 — Comparative Perspectives on Political Violence

**Chair:** [Hojung Joo](https://www.hojungjoo.com) (Harvard University)

- **[Angela Alonso](https://www.angelaalonso.org/en) and [Regina Bateson](https://www.reginabateson.com/)** — *Lethal Political Violence in Brazil (2003–2023)*
    - Primary discussant: Regina Bateson
    - Secondary discussant: Hilary Izatt
- **[Sophia Solomon](https://politics.virginia.edu/people/sophia-solomon)** — *Ultra-Hooligans and the Political Mechanism of Sports Violence*
    - Primary discussant: Josephine Lechartre
    - Secondary discussant: Sam Fuller
- **[George Melios](https://www.georgemelios.com/)** — *Propaganda, Mobilisation, and Repression in Greece*
    - Primary discussant: Lennart Schürmann
    - Secondary discussant: Amnon Cavari

## Panel 2 — The Effect of Personal Experience and Social Norms on (Anti-)Democratic Attitudes and Support for Political Violence

**Chair:** [Marko Kljajic](https://www.markokljajic.com/) (Harvard University)

- **[Miku Matsunaga](https://mikumatsunaga.github.io/)** — *Did You Do That on Purpose? The Unintended Impact of Mainstream Accommodation on Violence Justification Attitudes*
    - Primary discussant: Sam Fuller
    - Secondary discussant: Elias Koch
- **[Daniel Goldstein](https://daniel-a-n-goldstein.com/)** — *The Moral Question: Norms and Anti-System Politics*
    - Primary discussant: Lucas Woodley
    - Secondary discussant: Marko Kljajic
- **[Josephine Lechartre](https://www.josephinelechartre.com/)** — *Human Rights or Criminals' Rights? How Crime and Insecurity Undermine Support for Human Rights in Latin America*
    - Primary discussant: Neeraj Prasad
    - Secondary discussant: Angela Alonso

## Panel 3 — National Trends and Shocks in (Anti-)Democratic Attitudes

**Chair:** [Hilary Izatt](https://www.hilaryizatt.com/) (Binghamton University)

- **[Amnon Cavari](https://www.runi.ac.il/en/faculty/cavari)** — *Rallying Around Democracy: Public Evaluation of Democratic Quality During War*
    - Primary discussant: Miku Matsunaga
    - Secondary discussant: Sophia Solomon
- **[Lucas Woodley](https://caps.gov.harvard.edu/directory/lucas-woodley/)** — *Tracking the Erosion of Democratic Norms: Panel Evidence Spanning the 2024 US Presidential Election*
    - Primary discussant: Daniel Goldstein
    - Secondary discussant: Gal Bitton
- **[Lennart Schürmann](https://schuermannl.github.io/)** — *Defending Democracy: Quasi-Experimental Evidence of the Effect of State Action on Public Support for Democracy*
    - Primary discussant: George Melios
    - Secondary discussant: Jack Rametta

Each paper has two discussants: a primary discussant from within the paper's subfield, and a secondary discussant from outside it.
